When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the stacks and be replaced with Siphon Starlium, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) plus (+10*Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only 20% against non-hero units). Siphon Starlium can trigger on all enemies in front of Ixia that are within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot critically strike. Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.

Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 100 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area. When hitting enemy heroes, Ixia gains 50% Movement Speed for 2s. Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.

Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies. After a short delay, it pulls enemies in range to the center line and deals 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Full Barrage state for 4s. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in the large fan-shaped area in front of her, but not outside it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

Each time Jawhead deals damage to an enemy hero or a Creep, he inflicts a stack of Mecha Suppression on them for 3s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack of Mecha Suppression increases all damage dealt to the target by 2% (limited to 50% for Creeps).
Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5s, each missile dealing 135 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit.

Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s. Use Again: Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5s. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.

Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning them. Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.
When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a 300 (+700% Total Physical Defense) shield for 10s. Cooldown: 100s.
Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing 120 (+220% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8s.

Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 120 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, reducing their Movement Speed and Magic Defense by 10% (stacks up to 3 times) for 2s. While his shield is raised, Johnson can perform Basic Attacks and cast skills.

Passive: Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10%. Active: Johnson transforms into a car. Nearby allied heroes can use Hop In to ride with him (only 1 at a time). When the car hits an enemy hero, it explodes and deals 300 (+240% Total Physical Defense)–450 (+360% Total Physical Defense) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5–1s (scales with driving time). It also creates an electrified zone at the location that continuously deals 60 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slows enemies within. Johnson's location is revealed to enemies for 3s when he casts this skill.

Joy becomes Angry! each time her skill hits a non-Minion enemy, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and increasing her Movement Speed by 60% that decays over 4s (hitting the Leonin Crystal will also grant the Movement Speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4s for each target. Joy's Basic Attack will deal 65 (+65% Total Physical Attack) (+65% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Joy summons a Leonin Crystal at the target location, dealing 200 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The Leonin Crystal lasts up to 2s.

Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal allows Joy to cast this skill again within 0.8s and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on the beat increases the skill damage by 100% and grants a 80 (+60% Total Magic Power) shield that lasts 3s. This skill can be cast up to 4 times in succession.

Joy gains 15 (+10% Total Magic Power) Hybrid Defense and 30% Movement Speed. Over the next 3s, she pulses 8 times, dealing 120 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each time to nearby enemies. Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy! cast on the beat increases this skill's damage by 40%. If perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting every beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active. This skill unlocks when Joy acquires Beat Energy. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy will remove all debuffs and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.

After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9-6s Cooldown (decreases with his level). After casting any skill, his Basic Attacks for the next 2s will deal 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and pull the target toward him (deals 85% damage to Creeps). Casting another skill extends the duration. Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5s each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).

Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 420 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.
Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing 400 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.
Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

Kadita gains the Blessing of the Ocean every 30s. Taking damage from an enemy hero activates the Blessing for 4s. When the Blessing ends, she recovers 65% of the HP lost during this period (damage from minions and creeps does not activate this effect). While in the River, Kadita gains 10% extra Movement Speed.

Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain. Use Again: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.

After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s. Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.

Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions, each dealing 270 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a delay, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit. While underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed. This skill can only be interrupted by Suppression.
Upon retrieving the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains a 450 (+80% Total Magic Power) shield, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5s, and slows them by 60% for 1s. Cooldown: 4.5s.

Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 365 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away. This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.
Kagura removes all debuffs on her and leaps in the target direction, while leaving the Seimei Umbrella behind.
Kagura invokes the power of the Seimei Umbrella, dealing 250 (+95% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.
Kaja's skill damage applies the Paralysis effect to enemy units, briefly slowing heroes or summoned units and reducing their damage by 8% for 5s.

Kaja summons a ring of Primal Lightning that expands and returns to him. Enemies hit take 160 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and recover 78 (+45% Total Magic Power) HP to Kaja. Healing from subsequent hits is reduced to 33%.

Kaja dashes to the target area, gaining Control Immunity during the dash. On arrival, he deals 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, knocking back and stunning nearby enemies for 0.5s, then enters the Soaring state. The Soaring state lasts 6.6s. During this time, he ignores obstacles and gains 15% Movement Speed, but his turn radius is restricted. He can use Basic Attacks while moving, dealing 100 (+25% Total Magic Power) (+ 2% target's HP) Magic Damage to surrounding enemies. Each Basic Attack hit extends the Soaring state by 0.2s. Upon entering the Soaring state, the cooldown of Soaring Wings is reduced to 4s (unaffected by Cooldown Reduction). Hitting an enemy with Soaring Wings extends the Soaring state by 2.6s.

Kaja hurls a Primal Lightning Lasso at the target area. After a 0.5s delay, all enemy heroes remaining in the area take 360 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and are trapped for 2.5s. While active, Kaja can drag the lasso, shrinking its radius and pulling enemies at the boundary along with him (does not interrupt their skills).

After casting a skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she will absorb it to enhance her next three Basic Attacks with different effects: First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 120 (+10% Max HP) (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for herself and the nearby lowest HP ally. Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, dealing 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and creating a new Water Zone. Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.
Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 200 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5s.

Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience) while dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a Water Zone during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s (unaffected by Resilience).

Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction (drag the Joystick to change landing spot). She gains Control Immunity during this process. Upon landing, deals 300 (+14% Max HP) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Karina's third consecutive attack against the same enemy deals 100 (+ 5 (+2.5% Total Magic Power)% target's Lost HP) extra True Damage. If the target is an enemy hero, this attack also reduces the cooldowns of her non-Ultimate skills by 1.5s. Damage dealt to creeps is capped at 2000 True Damage.

Karina enters the Dance of Blades state for up to 3.5s, gaining 45% Movement Speed and blocking all Basic Attacks. Blocked attacks trigger a counterattack that deals 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the attacker (firing a Shadowblade at ranged attackers or triggering Dance of Blades against melee attackers). This effect has a 0.4s cooldown). Casting a Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Dance of Blades state, empowering Karina's next Basic Attack to deal 160 (+60% Total Magic Power) critical Magic Damage and slow the target by 45% for 1s.
Karina launches a spinning slash, dealing 375 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Karina dashes to the enemy hero, dealing 350 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, applying a Shadow Sigil to the target, and leaving a Shadowform behind them. The Shadow Sigil and Shadowform both last 5s. If the target dies during this time, this skill's cooldown resets immediately. Use Again: Karina dashes back to the Shadowform's location, dealing 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Lightwheel Mark on hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of Lightwheel Marks, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing True Damage equal to 5 of the target's HP to them (only up to 5 damage against creeps).

Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150 (+10% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.

Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark on them. When in Dual Wield state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.

Karrie enters Dual Wield state for 10s, gaining 30% Movement Speed. Each Basic Attack deals 50 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and throws 2 lightwheels that inherit a portion of Attack Effects.

Khaleed accumulates Desert Power while moving. After Desert Power is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal 50 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (cannot Crit), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5s.

Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 175 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row. This skill deals 60% damage to Minions and Creeps.

Khaleed protects himself with the power of the quicksand, restoring 60-135 plus 5%-10% of his lost HP and 10 Desert Power every 0.5 seconds, reducing damage taken by 35%-50% for up to 4 seconds. While channeling, quicksand appears under his feet, slowing the enemy by 60%. This skill is a Focused Cast. Any other controls will interrupt this skill.

Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process. Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing 450 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1s, and fully charge his Desert Power.

Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 8s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals 100 (+120% Total Physical Attack) (+ 6% target's HP) Magic Damage. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and recovers 8% of his HP on hit. Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4s.

Khufra pulls the bandages on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing 50 (+ 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his HP) Physical Damage to all enemies on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering the first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing 50 (+ 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his HP) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for up to 1s.

Khufra uses bandages to wrap himself into a Bouncing Ball, increasing his Hybrid Defense by 30%. Enemies trying to use mobility skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne. Each time the Bouncing Ball hits the ground, it deals 50 (+ 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of his HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 80% for 0.2s.

Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them down for 1.25s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra Physical Damage equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.

Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her Spray Gun, but cannot lock on to a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun attack deals Magic Damage. Hitting enemy heroes/non-hero units restores 6/3 Starlium. At max Starlium, Kimmy's Basic Attacks are enhanced to deal damage and pierce through targets. Kimmy doesn't stop moving while shooting and no longer benefits from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed she gains is converted to 1 Magic Power.

Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to slow effects. She can pass through terrain and gains 120% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1s. During the flight, she continuously fires 4 Chemical Bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing 20 (+25% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s. Kimmy does not consume Starlium during flight.

Kimmy fires a Starlium Beam in the target direction, immobilizing enemies in its path and dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage for 1s. Each enemy hero hit grants 20 Starlium.

Kimmy charges up and fires a Traction Pulse in the target direction. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes, dealing 150 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+54% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and creating a force field that slows enemies within by 50%. After 1s, the field contracts, pulling enemy heroes within it to its center and dealing 15% of their current HP as Magic Damage. It also slows them by 50% for 2s. Each enemy hero hit grants Kimmy 40 Starlium.
Each time Lancelot charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4s, up to 30%.

Lancelot charges in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and marking the first unmarked enemy hit with Sword Mark for 3s. If a new Sword Mark is applied, this skill's cooldown resets.

Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing 220 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (damage is reduced when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable during this process. Enemies in the center of the area take all the 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5s. The slow effect can stack.

After a short delay, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing 350 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. He is invincible throughout the process.

Each time Lapu-Lapu deals damage, he gains 10 Bravery Blessing (halved from non-hero units). When his Bravery Blessing is full, his next Basic Attack or Justice Blades will be enhanced, granting Lapu-Lapu a shield that can absorb 250 (+65*Hero Level) damage for 2.5 seconds. The enhanced Basic Attack) will cause him to dash toward the target, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. This Basic Attack cannot be a critical hit. The enhanced Justice Blades will slow the target by 60% for 1 second.

Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction, each boomerang dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit on its way out and back. Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.
Lapu-Lapu dashes in the target direction, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.

Lapu-Lapu leaps to the target location while combining his twin blades into one, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies upon landing and slowing them by 60% for 1s. Lapu-Lapu gains 3 times the normal amount of Bravery Blessing from this skill and skills cast in the transformed state. Lapu-Lapu then enters the Great Sword stance for 10s, gaining 30 Hybrid Defense, enhancing all his skills, and increasing his Basic Attack damage to 120%. This skill cannot be interrupted.
Layla's damage increases with distance, from 100% to 115% at 6 units or farther. This effect does not apply to Turrets.

Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit (can Crit). If Malefic Bomb hits an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3s. She also gains 60% Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s. The Movement Speed boost lasts twice as long if an enemy hero is hit.

Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target, dealing 170 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies and applying a Magic Mark to the target for 3s. When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals 100 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.25s.

Passive: The range of Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units. Layla's sight range is slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded. Active: Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line.

Leomord's Basic Attacks and skills grant him 25 Oath Keeper energy each time they deal damage to targets. When the energy reaches 100, his next Basic Attack deals 200% Crit Damage and restores 100 (+10*Hero Level) (+15% Extra Max HP) HP. Leomord's Basic Attacks cannot normally Crit, and every 1% Crit Chance is converted into 1% Crit Damage. Mounted State: Each Oath Keeper energy gain is increased by 200%.

Leomord begins channeling, slowing enemies in the target direction by 25%. When the channeling is complete or interrupted, he thrusts his sword in the same direction, dealing up to 500 (+180% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (scales with channeling time; increased to 140% against creeps except the Turtle and Lord) and slowing them by 40% for 1s. Use Again: Cast the skill again to cancel the channeling and immediately perform the thrust.
Leomord charges in a designated direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.

Leomord summons Barbiel to rush to him, knocking back and dealing 100 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path. If Barbiel comes in contact with Leomord, they will enter the Mounted State, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s. Mounted State: Leomord gains a brand-new set of skills, and his Basic Attack can be used while moving and hits a circular area to deal AOE damage. Leomord also gains 70 Movement Speed and 30 Hybrid Defense. This lasts 10s.

If Lesley doesn't take damage for 5s, her next Basic Attack gains extra range and 50% Crit Chance and deals 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack) True Damage (20% extra damage against minions). Each point of fixed Physical Penetration and each 1% Physical Penetration Lesley acquires is converted into 1% Crit Damage, but her base Crit Damage is reduced to 130%. Lesley's Basic Attack restores 5 points of energy and her Lethal Shot doubles the amount of energy restored. The Lethal Shot effect will activate immediately after Lesley uses a skill.

Lesley enters the Camouflage state, gaining double Energy Regen, 40% extra Movement Speed, and 85 extra Physical Attack. The state lasts 3s or until Lesley takes or deals damage. Enemies can detect Lesley's position through distortions of their surroundings.

Lesley throws a tactical grenade in the target direction while jumping back slightly, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and knocking them back. Lesley can cast this skill during Ultimate Snipe to cancel the state and immediately fire a Fatal Bullet at the target. The attack is only triggered when there are unfired Fatal Bullets left.

Passive: Lesley's Crit Chance is increased by 10%. Active: Lesley locks onto an enemy hero and fires 4 Fatal Bullets in succession. Each bullet deals 250 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 5% of the target's lost HP) Physical Damage and restores 10 Energy on hit. Bullets can be blocked by other enemy heroes. If this skill is interrupted, each remaining bullet reduces this skill's cooldown by 10%.

Ling's superb Lightness Skill allows him to leap among walls. He gains 4 extra Lightness Points per second when he's on a wall and 5 extra Lightness Points each time he deals damage. Ling gains 1.6 times Crit Chance from all sources but only has 140% Crit Damage.

Passive: Ling's Crit Chance is increased by 2.5%. Active: Ling leaps onto the designated wall and enters the Half-Stealth state, restoring Lightness Points faster and gaining 30% Movement Speed. Taking damage causes him to leave Half-Stealth. Being controlled makes him fall to the ground and slows him by 30% for 2s. When he uses this skill to jump from one wall to another, it does not trigger cooldown and refreshes Half-Stealth.

Ling charges in the target direction and stabs nearby enemies, dealing them 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If Ling casts this skill when he's on the wall (no energy cost), he'll dash to the target location on the ground, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Defiant Sword is regarded as Basic Attack.

Ling leaps into the air, becoming invincible and gaining 10% extra Movement Speed for 1.5s. He ignores obstacles when in the air. He then lands on the ground, dealing 250 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, knocking those in the center airborne for 1s, and creating a Sword Field for 8s. Four Tempest of Blades will also appear on the edge of the Sword Field. Ling can touch them to reduce the cooldown of Finch Poise by 4s, reset the cooldown of Defiant Sword, and gain 25 Lightness Points.

Every 6s to 3s (scales with Noumenon Blast level), the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita 20 (+2.5% Max HP) (+20% Total Magic Power) shield. When Lolita casts a skill, the Noumenon Energy Core grants Lolita and nearby allied heroes an extra shield. This shield can stack up to 3 times and lasts 30s.

Lolita dashes in the target direction. Her next Basic Attack within 4s will perform a short dash to the target, dealing 400 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 0.5s. This damage is doubled against Minions.

Lolita raises her shield and reflects all incoming ranged Basic Attacks and Projectiles in the direction of the shield for 3s. The shield will break after taking 1000 (+15% Max HP) damage. The damage and effects from the Unique Passives of an attacker's equipment will not apply to the shield and will not be reflected. This skill can be interrupted by high level control effects.

Passive: Reduces the interval of Noumenon Energy Core by 1s each time this skill is upgraded. Active: Lolita begins charging for 2s while slowing enemies in a fan-shaped area by 60%. When the charging is complete or is stopped, Lolita slams her hammer on the ground, dealing up to 600 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for up to 2s (damage and stun duration scale with charge time). Use Again: Lolita immediately stops charging and slams her hammer on the ground.

Lukas gains 0.5 Resolve per second and 3.5 Resolve when dealing damage to heroes. Upon reaching 100 Resolve, he can use Unleash the Beast to transform into Sacred Beast. Sacred Beast: Greatly increases combat attributes. He continuously consumes Resolve and ends when Resolve is depleted.

Passive: Basic Attacks grant Vigor (up to 2 stacks), each stack lasting 4s. Vigor enhances Flash Combo. Lukas consumes all Vigor to unleash Pulverize, dealing 400 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovering 8% of his HP when hitting a hero or minion. 1 Stack: Lukas briefly stuns the target and spins his tonfa hammers to deal 95 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times, pulling the enemy toward him. 2 Stacks: Lukas briefly stuns the target, then delivers 2 attacks dealing 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each. Afterward, he spins his tonfa hammers, dealing 95 (+25% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage 3 times while gaining Control Immunity for the duration.

Lukas dashes in the target direction, empowering his next Basic Attack within 4s into Flash Strike. Flash Strike: Lukas dashes behind the enemy, dealing 60 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He then gains 20% Movement Speed and Attack Speed for 4s. During this time, his next Basic Attack gains increased Attack Range and triggers a sacred lightning that deals 110 (+50% Total Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage.

First Cast: Lukas transforms into his Sacred Beast form (briefly gains Control Immunity). His base Movement Speed is increased by 30, all attributes are increased by 15%, and his skills gain new effects. Use Again: Fires a Shockwave Blast in the target direction that explodes upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its maximum range, dealing 450 (+155% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. All attributes: HP, Physical Attack, Physical Defense, Magic Defense, Attack Speed, and Attack Range.
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order. When Lunox uses Power of Order, she gains 10% Spell Vamp. When she uses Power of Chaos, she gains 10% Magic Penetration.

Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing 200 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The starlight then returns to Lunox, each recovering 75 (+30% Total Magic Power) HP to her (doubled when hitting enemy heroes). This skill shares a cooldown with Chaos Assault. It grants Power of Order and ends the Power of Chaos state.

Lunox unleashes Chaos Energy at a target enemy, dealing 250 (+120% Total Magic Power) (+ 3.5% target's HP) Magic Damage (+ 2.1% against creeps). This skill shares its cooldown with Starlight Pulse. Using it grants Power of Chaos and ends the Power of Order state.

Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order. When Power of Order is dominant, she can cast Brilliance to become invincible and deal continuous damage to nearby enemies. When Power of Chaos is dominant, she can cast Darkening to blink in a target direction and greatly reduce the cooldown of Chaos Assault for a brief period.

Luo Yi's skills can create Sigils of Yin/Yang on the battlefield. Each Sigil lasts up to 6s. Sigils of opposite attributes will trigger Yin-Yang Reaction when they are within a certain distance, dealing 300 (+25*Hero Level) (+190% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the marked enemies, stunning them for 0.3s, and pulling them toward each other. Each time Luo Yi applies a new Sigil to a marked enemy, she gains a 300 (+10*Hero Level) (+150% Total Magic Power) shield (up to 3 stacks) and 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2s.

Luo Yi casts the energy of Yin/Yang in the target direction, dealing 285 (+135% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and those behind them in a fan-shaped area. Enemy heroes hit are marked with a Sigil of Yin/Yang. Luo Yi stores up to 4 Dispersion charges and gains 1 charge every 8s. She also immediately gains 1 charge each time Yin-Yang Reaction is triggered. The state of this skill changes on each cast.

Luo Yi summons Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin at the target location, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s. Fire of Yang / Aqua of Yin then remains at the location for 6s, dealing 50 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.7s to nearby enemies. It can also trigger Yin-Yang Reaction with Sigils of opposite attributes. The state of this skill changes on each cast.

Passive: Luo Yi's Cooldown Reduction is increased by 6%. Active: Luo Yi creates a Teleport Circle around herself and marks the target location (within 28 units) as its destination. After a 3s delay, allied heroes within the Circle will be teleported to the location.

Lylia gains power from Gloom, increasing her Movement Speed by 15%. Each Gloom upgrade further increases this bonus by 5%. Gloom gains an upgrade each time he devours Shadow Energy, up to 5 times. Higher levels increase the detonation damage of Shadow Energy.

Lylia sends out Gloom with a shockwave, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. If Gloom touches Shadow Energy, he will devour and detonate it.

Lylia condenses Shadow Energy at the target area, dealing 90 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and briefly slowing them by 80%. Shadow Energy detonates when devoured by Gloom, dealing 220 (+115% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Each Gloom upgrade increases the detonation damage by 20% (up to 80%). Gloom restores 20% of Shadow Energy's recharge time upon hitting an enemy hero. Lylia starts with the Shadow Energy skill, storing one charge every 6s.
Lylia returns to the Black Shoes' location 4s ago, restoring her HP and Mana to their previous state and recovering an extra 10% HP. She also gains 20% Movement Speed for 2s.

Marcel's split soul, Clemar, enters the camera to freeze the moment. His Basic Attacks deal 50 (+40% Total Physical Attack)(+40% Total Magic Defense)(+40% Total Physical Defense) Physical Damage. His Extra HP is converted into 1.5% Hybrid Defense. Clemar automatically snaps photos of enemy heroes near Marcel, causing a brief Frozen Moment and dealing 20 (+ 5% of HP) True Damage (triggers Attack Effects). It also grants a shield of the same value to Marcel and a nearby allied hero. Cooldown: 12s per target.

Clemar focuses on an area around Marcel, slowing enemy heroes within by 60%. After 2.5s, he completes the shot, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack)(+120% Total Magic Defense)(+120% Total Physical Defense) Physical Damage to enemies within.

Artist inspiration time! Marcel enters the Tracking Haste state for 3s, gaining 15% Movement Speed. This bonus increases to 75% when moving toward an enemy hero. Use Again: Marcel dashes in the target direction, leaving a framing phantom behind while the Framed Moment area remains at the original location.

Marcel and Clemar perform a joint shoot. After a short delay, Clemar takes a wide-angle shot of the target area for 2s. During this time, Marcel enters the Tracking Haste state while inside the area. All other units in the area are put into a Frozen Moment and are immune to all effects except from Marcel. All projectiles are also frozen and will continue after a delay (targeted projectiles will deal 50% damage). Golden Hour resets the cooldown of Platinum Snap for each enemy hero. Allied heroes with the Platinum Snap shield can move freely within the area.
Each time Martis uses a skill, his Attack Speed will be increased by 30%, 120% maximum. Lasts 4s. He gains (+8*Hero Level) extra Attack at full stacks.
Martis draws enemies to a fan-shaped area in front of him and deals 350 (+130% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, slowing them by 40% for 2s.

Martis strikes in the target direction three times, each time dealing 225 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. Enemies hit by the first and third strike are also knocked back. The attack direction can be changed once using the Joystick. Use Again: Martis leaps in the target direction, dealing 300 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and knocking them airborne. Martis gains Control Immunity and 60% Damage Reduction when casting this skill.

Martis lunges at a designated enemy hero, dealing 700 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (deals True Damage if the enemy's HP is below 50%). If the enemy is killed by this skill, Martis can cast the skill again within 10s and gains 100% extra Movement Speed that gradually decays over 5s. Each successive cast also increases the skill's damage by 15% (up to 30%).

Bear's Blessing: Masha has 3 HP bars, each inheriting 50% of her Equipment HP bonuses. Each time an HP bar breaks, she removes control effects on herself and blocks one instance of damage. Dealing damage to enemy heroes or creeps builds Feral, which converts into HP after she leaves combat. Power of Wildness: When Masha's skills damage an enemy hero, a Wound appears on a random side of the target. Breaking a Wound with a Basic Attack puts her into the Feral state. Feral State: For 3s, Masha gains 15 (+1*Hero Level)% Resilience, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed. Her next 3 Basic Attacks become fan-shaped claw strikes, dealing extra Physical Damage equal to 3 (+0.5% Extra Physical Attack) (+0.2*Hero Level)% HP to enemies in the area (not against Turrets) and recovering 4 (+0.4*Hero Level)% HP. [C8Breaking another Wound during the Feral state refreshes the state's duration. Up to 6 claw strikes can be stored.]
Masha releases energy forward, dealing 250 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. It deals 150% damage to minions.

Masha dashes in the target direction, dealing 120 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing enemy heroes' Movement Speed by 50% for 1s on hit. [C8Whenever an HP bar is depleted, the cooldown of Claw Strike resets.]
Masha charges toward an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+50% Extra Max HP) Physical Damage and stunning them for 1s while knocking back nearby enemies.

Mathilda gains Ancestral Guidance while moving. When it's fully charged, her next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target and granting her 80 extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5s.

Mathilda resonates with the power of her ancestors for 4s, attracting wisps as her movement distance increases (up to 6 wisps). At the end of the skill's duration, or when Mathilda casts this skill again, the wisps will seek and attack nearby enemies, each dealing 275 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and revealing the enemies' positions briefly. Subsequent damage dealt by wisps to the same target decays to 40%.

Mathilda leaps in the target direction and creates a field around her, gaining a 350 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield and 25% extra Movement Speed for 3s. Allied heroes who come into contact with the field will receive a 50% shield and Guiding Wind. The first allied hero that triggers Guiding Wind will be guided to Mathilda, and both of them will gain the same Movement Speed boost. When casting this skill during Circling Eagle, Mathilda won't change her position. Guiding Wind expires 2s after the hero leaves Mathilda's field.

Mathilda applies a Soul Mark to the target enemy hero and circles around them for up to 3.5s, during which her wisps will fly into nearby enemies, each dealing 40 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The Soul Mark will also slow the target by 15% and Soul Bloom will prioritize the target with Soul Mark. Within the duration, Mathilda can select an area to dash to. At the end of the duration, she'll dash at the target with Soul Mark, dealing 320 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage while knocking enemies in her path airborne for 0.6s, transferring the Soul Mark to the first enemy hero that she knocks airborne, and reducing the skill cooldown by 40%. Mathilda gains Control Immunity and a 400 (+180% Total Magic Power) shield for the skill duration.
My tailor shop excels at fixing and 'fixing' dolls. Am I right, Muddles? (Melissa deals 125% damage to Minions, Creeps, and Summoned Units.)
Watch me slide forward and boost Attack Speed for 2.5 seconds— Ah, that was just boring… "Muddles, go that way!" "Cuddles, come here!"

The plan goes like this: Throw Muddles out to pin down the bad guys, and then... I take center stage! "I pierce the bad guys while Giggles hits Muddles to give them a beating too! Hee, fantastic!" (Muddles deals 175 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on the first hit and links nearby enemies for up to 6s. Linked enemies are slowed by 60%, decaying over 1.5s. They can break the link by moving out of range. Muddles returns to Melissa early if no enemies are nearby, or immediately if Melissa moves too far away. When Muddles is present, attack it directly. Attacking it this way cannot trigger multi-hit damage. Giggles only hits Muddles when Melissa has a Basic Attack target. Each hit on Muddles deals 50% of that damage to linked enemies.)

Cuddles, protect me! For 4 seconds, let no bad guys come close. Unless I say otherwise! (Upon activation, Melissa gains a 300 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield and knocks back enemies in the area, dealing 500 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemies attempting to enter the field are knocked back, taking 50 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowed briefly. Movement skills are interrupted unless the target has Control Immunity. The field will move with Melissa once, when she's about to move out of the boundary.)
After casting a skill, Minotaur gains Motivation, recovering HP equal to 5 (+1*Hero Level)% of damage taken from enemy heroes for 3s. Enraged State: Motivation HP recovery is increased to 200%.

Minotaur jumps to the target location, dealing 325 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and briefly knocking them airborne. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 40% while Minotaur enhances his Basic Attacks to deal 25 (+5% Max HP) extra Physical Damage for 2s. Enraged: Increases the AOE range and the damage dealt by 25 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage.

Minotaur heals himself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP, recovering 220 (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for both. He also recovers an additional 8% of his lost HP. Enraged: Minotaur heals himself and all nearby allied heroes.

Minotaur enters Enraged state and smashes the ground 3 times. The first 2 hits deal 180 (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slow them by 60%, while the final hit deals 200 (+85% Total Physical Attack) True Damage and knocks targets airborne for 0.8s. Minotaur is immune to control effects during this attack. The Enraged state lasts 12s and enhances Minotaur's skills for the duration.

Minsitthar's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Mark of the King, up to 5 stacks. Upon reaching max stacks, the next attack detonates all Mark of the King stacks, dealing Physical Damage equal to 400 (+6% Max HP) of Minsitthar's Max HP and stunning the target for 0.8s while healing Minsitthar for 400 (+6% Max HP) HP. Can only trigger once every 6s on the same target.

Minsitthar thrusts the Spear of Glory forward, dealing 175 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing enemies hit by 30%. Enemy heroes hit by the spear tip are stunned for 0.3s. After a short delay, Minsitthar pulls the spear back, dealing 175 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in its path and pulling enemy heroes toward him. Pulled heroes are stunned for up to 0.8s based on the distance pulled.

Minsitthar awakens the power in his shield and releases it, dealing 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in a rectangular area and slowing them by 80% (decaying rapidly over 2s). Meanwhile, he enters Phalanx state for 3s, reducing damage taken from the front by 25% and enhancing his Basic Attack to swiftly strike an area in front of him for 100 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per hit.

Minsitthar charges forward and calls 4 Royal Guards to form a field around him. The Royal Guards cannot move but will attack enemies in the field for (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies in the field are slowed by 20% and cannot use movement skills.

Each time Miya's Basic Attack hits a target, she gains 5% Attack Speed for 4s (up to 5 stacks). At maximum stacks, each Basic Attack also summons a Moonlight Shadow to attack the target, dealing 25 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, inheriting 20% Attack Effects.

Miya's Basic Attacks shoot 2 extra Split Arrows, each inheriting 30% of Attack Effects. They deal 10 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the primary target and 30% damage to other targets. This effect lasts 4s.

Miya calls upon the power of Moon Eclipse in the target area, dealing 270 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s. The attack then splits into 6 arrows that scatter in different directions. Each arrow deals 40 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies hit by 30% for 2s.

Miya removes all debuffs and enters the Conceal state, gaining 65% Movement Speed for up to 2s (attacking ends the state early). Upon exiting the Conceal state, Miya gains maximum stacks of Moon Blessing.

Moskov's Basic Attacks can penetrate the target and deal [(+65% (+3%*Hero Level) Physical Attack) ] to enemies behind them (inherits Attack Effects). Each Basic Attack hit reduces the cooldowns of Abyss Walker and Spear of Misery by 0.5 seconds.
Moskov teleports to the target location, increasing his Attack Speed to 1.15–1.5 times for 3 seconds. Meanwhile, his Basic Attack deals 10% more damage to enemies behind the primary target.

Moskov launches a powerful strike at the target enemy hero or creep, dealing 300 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, knocking them back, and revealing their position for 2s. If the target collides with an enemy hero when knocked back, they'll both take 200 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and be stunned for 1.2s. The target is also stunned for the same duration if they collide with a wall.

After a short delay, Moskov throws the Spear of Destruction in the target direction, dealing 340 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Enemies behind the first enemy hero hit take 10% extra damage. All enemies hit are slowed by 50% for 1s. The slow duration increases with the spear's travel distance, up to 3s. When Spear of Destruction hits an enemy hero, it creates a shadow behind them and resets Abyss Walker's cooldown. Use Again: Moskov casts Abyss Walker from the shadow's location (shares a cooldown with Skill 1).

Upon taking fatal damage, Molina's Gift removes all debuffs from Nana and transforms her for 2s. While transformed, Nana is immune to all damage, gains 30% Movement Speed, and recovers 10% HP per second, but cannot cast skills. This effect can trigger only once every 150s.

Nana hurls her Magic Boomerang in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it hits as it travels out and returns. The first enemy hit takes full damage. Damage is reduced by 10% each additional enemy hit, up to a maximum total reduction of 70%.

Nana throws Molina at the target location, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within range and Transforming enemy heroes hit into small animals. If Molina does not hit an enemy hero, she will remain on the ground and chase the nearest enemy hero that comes into range, Transforming the first enemy hero she touches. Transform: Reduces the target's Movement Speed by 50% and Magic Defense by 30% for 1.5s. Transformed heroes cannot attack or use skills.

Nana summons Molina to strike the target area 3 times, each dealing 440 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies in the area by 30% for 1s. Consecutive hits from Molina Blitz on the same enemy stun them for 1s.

If Natalia stays in a bush without taking damage for 1s, she will enter Camouflage state and gain 15% Movement Speed. In this state, Natalia's next Basic Attack will teleport her behind her target and deal 200 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage while silencing the target for 0.25s. Dealing damage, taking damage or using skills will immediately end the Camouflage state, but her next Basic Attack will remain enhanced for another 1s. Natalia's base Crit Damage is reduced to 150%, but her damage to Creeps is increased to 150%.
Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path. Use Again: Hitting an enemy allows Natalia to recast this skill within 5s.
Natalia releases a Smoke Bomb at her location, slowing enemies within by 25% while Natalia becomes immune to enemy Basic Attacks for 4s.

Passive: Natalia gains 15% Crit Chance. Active: Natalia immediately enters the Assassin Instinct state. She can store up to 2 Ultimate charges, and each charge has a recharge time of 30s. Killing creeps reduces the remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.

Natan gains a stack of Entanglement each time he or his Reverse-Clone hits an enemy with a skill (up to 6 stacks). Each stack lasts 2.5s and grants 7.5% Attack Speed and 5% Movement Speed. Natan's Basic Attack projectiles will return to Natan after reaching the maximum range, dealing an extra 30 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way (inherits a portion of Attack Effects). Hitting an enemy refreshes Entanglement's duration.
Natan shoots a dense mass of energy in the target direction, dealing 225 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.

Natan launches a Gravitational Attractor in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and knocking them back. The Attractor detonates upon reaching the maximum range, dealing 30 (+10% Total Physical Attack) (+12% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back.

Natan summons a Reverse-Clone that lasts 10s at 6 units away. The Reverse-Clone copies his moves and attacks in reverse and inherits 35% of his Basic Attack and skill damage. Use Again: Natan switches places with the Reverse-Clone. Each cast reduces other skills' remaining cooldowns by 50%. The Reverse-Clone will disappear if Natan is too far away.

Nolan's skills will leave a Rift that lasts 5 seconds and slows enemies by 30%. When a rift comes into contact with another rift, they will activate and pull enemies to their center and deal 220 (+140% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage after a short delay. Each time a rift activation hits an enemy hero or Creep, Nolan will gain 15 Energy and heals 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) for himself. If an enemy is hit by multiple rift activations, the damage after the first hit will be reduced to 40%. Cosmic Leap: If Nolan does not deal or take damage for 5 seconds, he enhances his next Basic Attack to dash to the target, dealing (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a rift. (Damage to and from Minions or Creeps will not prevent Nolan from getting this effect.)
Nolan cuts a rectangular area in front of him with his cosmic gauge, dealing 230 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and leaving a Rift at the first enemy hit.
Nolan charges in the target direction and slashes with his cosmic gauge, dealing 70 (+13% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and leaving a Rift.

Nolan slashes at the target location 3 times, dealing 120 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with each slash while leaving 3 rifts and slowing the target hit by 30% for 0.5s. The rifts will be activated automatically while Nolan dashes backward.
Astral Sphere continuously slows nearby enemies by 20% and reveals their position.

Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at the target location, dealing 75 (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.33s and continuously slowing enemies (up to 2.5 times). After 2s, the Astral Sphere explodes, dealing 260 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+ 4% target's HP) Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 2.5 times.

First Cast: Novaria summons an Astral Sphere at a distance and draws it toward her. She gains 80% Movement Speed (decays to 30%) and can pass through obstacles. Use Again: Upon catching the Astral Sphere, she can cast Star Shatter to launch it in the target direction within 5s. Upon hitting an enemy hero, it deals 260 (+95% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's HP) Magic Damage to them and nearby heroes. The damage will increase based on the Astral Sphere's travel distance (draw + launch), up to 2.2 times the original damage.

Novaria scatters Astral Echo in the target direction, briefly slowing enemy heroes hit by 50% and applying Astral Ring on them. This increases their hitbox by 2.5 times and reveals their position for 5s.

When Obsidia deals damage to enemies, she gains Bone Energy (Basic Attacks against non-hero units grant 1 Energy, against hero units grant 2 Energy, and skills grant 3 times the Energy. No Energy is gained from hitting creeps). When Bone Energy reaches 30, it forms a Bone Shard, up to 25 shards. When Obsidia uses Basic Attacks, all Bone Shards strike the target, each dealing (7% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inheriting 7% Attack Effects.
Obsidia launches an Abyssal Bone Needle, dealing 325 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and triggering Return to Bone on the first enemy hero struck.
Obsidia descends into the Abyss and enters Shadowmeld Form, gaining 500% Movement Speed for 0.3s.

Obsidia shoots Bones of Wrath in the target direction, dealing 125 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and briefly stunning the first enemy hero hit before pulling herself to the target. The Bones of Wrath tethers Obsidia to the enemy, preventing her from moving more than 4 units away. While tethered, the enemy cannot use mobility skills, and their movement drags Obsidia along. Obsidia also gains 5 temporary Bone Shards stacks and a shield equal to 200 (+ 25 per Bone Shard stack). This effect lasts 3s. While tethered, Obsidia can move through obstacles and use Basic Attacks while moving. Phantom Shadowmeld is also enhanced: its duration increases to 1s, and its cooldown is reduced to 33%.

For 8s after casting a skill, Odette's next Basic Attack gains extra range and bounces between enemies (or an enemy and herself), dealing 144-200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage per hit. Odette's skills also trigger this effect on hit (up to 3 stacks).
Odette releases a magic swan in the target direction, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s.

Odette releases a group of magic orbs in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.5s. When an orb hits an enemy, it creates another orb that attacks a nearby enemy, prioritizing enemy heroes, dealing 250 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and immobilizing them for 1.5s.

Odette channels a dance, gaining a 1200 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield and dealing up to 2000 (+750% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies in a large area for 5s. During this time, her Movement Speed is reduced by 40%, but she can move freely. Use again to cancel. Only high-level control effects can interrupt this skill.

After every 3 skill casts, Paquito enters Champ Stance, gaining an enhanced skill ignoring his current cooldowns. He gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 2.5 seconds after casting the enhanced skill. Paquito's Basic Attacks only deal (+85% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Paquito throws a punch in the target direction, dealing 210 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and gaining a 150 (+135% Total Physical Attack) shield. Champ Stance: The damage is increased to 350 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, and the shield value is increased to 140% for 2.5s (normal and enhanced shields can stack).

Paquito dashes forward and throws a jab, dealing 200 (+165% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path and at the destination. Champ Stance: Paquito's jab becomes fiercer, dealing 300 (+210% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. The jab stops upon hitting a hero or creep.

Paquito launches an elbow strike at enemies in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them back to the destination. He then throws a haymaker, dealing 300 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 75% for 1s, before darting backward. Champ Stance: After knocking enemies back to the destination, Paquito launches an uppercut instead, dealing 400 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.

Every 5s to 8s (scales with Feathered Air Strike level), Verri enters the Hunting state. On Pharsa's next attack against an enemy hero, Verri deals extra Magic Damage equal to 8% of the target's HP (+ 1% per 200 Magic Power) and slows them by 60% for 1s.

Pharsa unleashes a blast of magic at the target location, dealing 300 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and marking them for 4s. When Pharsa hits a marked enemy with a Basic Attack or active skill, the mark is consumed, stunning them for 1s. Marked enemies will have their positions revealed.
Pharsa releases magic energy in the target direction, dealing 475 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

Passive: Each level-up reduces Spiritual Unity's interval by 1s. Active: Pharsa takes flight for 8s and bombards the target area, dealing 530 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within. This skill can be cast up to 4 times during the flight.

Phoveus's next Basic Attack charges at the enemy, knocking them back, dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 4% - 6% of the enemy's HP (scales with level), and gaining a 8% - 12% HP shield. Cooldown: 26s-14s (based on Infernal Pursuit's level). Astaros' Gaze: Whenever an enemy hero blinks, dashes, or is displaced within 8 units, reduces the cooldown of Demonic Force by 20% and other skills by 0.5s.

Phoveus slams his monolith into the ground, dealing 200 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 70% for 0.5s. If this skill hits an enemy, Phoveus's next Demonic Impact will leave behind an Astaros Eye. Astaros Eye: Implodes after a short delay, dealing 100 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Magic Damage to the enemies.
Phoveus lowers his monolith and releases his demonic power in the target direction, knocking enemies airborne, dragging them along, and dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Magic Damage.

Passive: Demonic Force, Astaros Eye, and Dark Wave can apply Sinner's Mark to the enemy hero hit. Active: Phoveus leaps into the air and smashes down with his monolith at the enemy hero with Sinner's Mark, dealing 250-500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) plus extra Physical Damage equal to 5% of the target's Max HP to enemies in the area while Phoveus recovers 50 plus 6% of his Lost HP. The HP recovered is reduced by 80% when hitting multiple enemies.

Kupa recovers 10% Max HP per second after not taking damage for 5s. When Kupa dies, Popol can Pray for 3s to revive it. Cooldown: 30s. Kupa has 3500 (+350*Hero Level) Max HP and inherits 100% of Popol's other attributes and equipment effects. Kupa deals 77 (+3*Hero Level) extra True Damage to creeps.

Popol throws a spear at the target, signaling Kupa to attack and dealing 80 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Kupa then bites the target, dealing 40 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 99% for 0.75s. While marked by the spear, whenever Popol or Kupa hits the target with a Basic Attack, both gain 7% Attack Speed and 3% Movement Speed for 4s (up to 3 stacks). Alpha Wolf Form: Kupa strikes fiercely, dealing 120 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies and knocking them airborne for 0.5s.

Popol calls Kupa back and gains a 240 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) shield. He can then ride Kupa for 1.5s, gaining 250 Movement Speed while mounted. Kupa also continuously recovers 20% of its Max HP. Popol can use a Basic Attack to end the Mounted state early. After returning, Kupa follows Popol until Popol attacks an enemy. Alpha Wolf Form: Shield effect increases to 125%, and Kupa recovers full HP while Mounted.
Popol and Kupa enter the Enraged state for 9s. During this time, Kupa turns into Alpha Wolf Form.

Rafaela can cast a special skill every 10s. After channeling for 2.5s, she instantly resurrects an ally and increases their Movement Speed by 30% for 5s (taking damage from heroes and Legend Creeps interrupts channeling and puts the skill on base cooldown). This skill's cooldown is increased by 600% of the target's remaining respawn time, capped at 240s. This skill is not affected by Cooldown Reduction.

Rafaela strikes the three nearest enemies with Light of Retribution, dealing them 350 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, briefly revealing their positions, and slowing them by 40% for 1.5s. Enemies hit by Light of Retribution again within 6s will take 20% extra damage (this effect stacks up to 3 times).

Rafaela calls upon Holy Light, recovering 100 (+35% Total Magic Power) HP to nearby allied heroes, plus an additional 150 (+65% Total Magic Power) HP to herself and the most injured allied hero in range. She also increases the Movement Speed of nearby allied heroes by 30% and grants Slow Immunity for 1s. Every 10 Magic Power increases the Movement Speed bonus by 1%.
Rafaela unleashes the true power of Holy Light in the target direction, dealing 460 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a line and stunning them for 1.2s.

Roger can freely switch between human and wolf forms. In human form, Roger's attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's current HP. In wolf form, his attack deals extra damage equal to 4% of the target's [lost C6HP]. Extra damage against creeps is capped at 60.

Roger fires two quick shots in the target direction, dealing a total of 250 (+125% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit. The first shot is a hunter net that slows the enemy by 80% for 1.5s. The second is a bullet that reduces the enemy's Physical Defense by 10 for 5s.
Roger gains 20% Movement Speed and 20% Attack Speed for 2.5s.

Roger lunges in the target direction and turns into wolf form, dealing 150 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 90% for 0.8s. Passive: In wolf form, Roger gains 20 Hybrid Defense and 25 Movement Speed.

Ruby's skills have a 75% Spell Vamp Ratio (her Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal). For every 1% HP lost, her Spell Vamp Ratio increases by 1%, up to 150%. After each skill cast, Ruby can dash to another location and gain 8-25 Hybrid Defense (scales with level) for 4s (stacks up to 3 times).

Ruby swings her scythe, dealing 280 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. She then unleashes a shockwave in the same direction, dealing 140 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s.
Ruby swings her scythe around herself twice, each swing dealing 60 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5s, and slowly pulling them toward her.
Ruby sweeps her scythe in the target direction, dealing 600 (+200% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit, pulling them toward her, and stunning them for 0.5s.
Each time Saber deals damage, he reduces the target's Physical Defense by 3-8 for 5s (up to 5 stacks).

Saber releases 5 swords that orbit around him and deal 75 (+25% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies on hit. The swords will retract back to him after the duration. While active, Sword attacks deal 200 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and 50% damage to enemies along the path (damage reduced to 50% against minions). Each sword attack reduces the cooldowns of Orbiting Swords by 0.5s and Charge by 1s.

Saber dashes in the target direction, dealing 75 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. After the dash, he gains an Enhanced Basic Attack that allows him to charge at the target, dealing 75 (+120% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

Saber charges at the target enemy hero, knocking them airborne for 1.2s (unaffected by Resilience). He strikes them 3 times over the duration, dealing 120 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the first 2 strikes and 240 (+160% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage with the third.

Selena can switch freely between her two forms. Elven Form: Selena applies "Abyssal Mark" with her skills. The mark can stack up to 2 times. When Abyssal Trap hits an enemy, it immediately adds an "Abyssal Mark". Abyssal Form: All damage will consume 1 stack of "Abyssal Mark" to deal 225 (+15*Hero Level) (+40% Total Magic Power) extra Magic Damage. "Abyssal Mark" deals 285% extra damage to non-hero units.

Selena summons an Abyssal Devil to lurk underground. The Abyssal Devil will attach itself to any enemy that approaches, inflicting a stack of Abyssal Mark and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. The Abyssal Devil then explodes, dealing 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and reducing their Movement Speed by 50% for 1s. Each additional Abyssal Devil on an enemy increases the final damage by 50%. Each Abyssal Devil can lurk up to 60s and up to 3 Abyssal Devils can exist at the same time.

Selena fires an abyssal wraith in the target direction that stops when it hits an enemy hero, Creep, or Summon, dealing 250 (+20% Total Magic Power) to 500 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target hit and stunning them for 0.5s to 2.5s while revealing their locations (the damage and stun duration increase with the wraith's travel distance). The wraith will pick up Abyssal Trap as it travels over it and will apply the trap to the enemy target upon stunning them. If the wraith stuns an enemy for 0.9s or longer, Selena will gain 60% Movement Speed for 2s.
Passive: Selena gains 5 Magic Power. Active: Selena enters Abyssal Form and gains 20% Movement Speed for 0.8s. This also immediately resets the cooldown of Soul Eater and Garotte.

Silvanna's Basic Attacks deal 25 (+45% Total Physical Attack) (+75% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Silvanna's attacks apply a mark on enemy heroes for 5s on hit, each mark reducing their Hybrid Defense by 3-6 (up to 5 stacks). Silvanna's skills and Basic Attacks deal 30% extra damage to enemy heroes with the max number of marks.

Silvanna dashes forward. Upon reaching the max range or hitting a non-Minion enemy, she swings her lance, dealing 250 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 1s.

Silvanna thrusts her lance in the target direction and spins it 6 times while gaining a 350 (+150% Total Magic Power) shield. Each spin deals 165 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slightly pulls targets toward the center. Silvanna spins 1 additional time for every 50% of extra Attack Speed she possesses. The skill deals only 50% damage against Minions. Spiral Strangling counts as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.

Silvanna leaps to the target location and creates a Circle of Light upon landing, dealing 350 (+110% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, slowing them by 40% for 1.5s, and restraining the closest enemy hero to the area for 3.5s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.) Silvanna gains 100% Attack Speed and 40% Lifesteal when in the Circle.

Sora can ascend to Thunder or Torrent by using his Ultimate. After ascending, dealing damage to heroes or summoned units grants 1 stack of Cloudstep. Upon reaching 5 stacks, he unlocks his True Art. Thunder: Adopts an assassin style, converting 30% HP into Physical Attack (Equal to 10% of HP). Torrent: Adopts a tank style, converting 30% Physical Attack into HP (Gains 10 HP for every 1 Attack).
Sora strikes twice, dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage, then lunges forward, dealing 240 (+5% Max HP) Physical Damage. He can dash after striking.

Sora leaps forward, dealing 140 (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If he hits an enemy hero or reaches max range, he slams the ground, dealing an additional 140 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 0.5s. Successful hits reduce the cooldown by 2s.

Swipe left to ascend into Thunder for 10s. Sora gains a brief bonus Movement Speed and becomes untargetable. He then summons lightning to strike nearby enemies 3 time(s), each dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Swipe right to ascend into Torrent for 10s. Sora gains Control Immunity. After a short delay, he pulls nearby enemies in and deals 250 (+8% Max HP) Physical Damage.

Enemies hit by Sun or his Doppelgangers will have their Physical Defense reduced by 5% (stacks up to 6 times). Sun recovers HP equal to 75 plus 15% of the Doppelganger's Physical Attack each time a Doppelganger deals damage. Sun or his Doppelgangers' Basic Attacks deal 65 extra damage to creeps.

Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 280 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Upon hitting an enemy hero or creep, or upon reaching maximum range, the Golden Staff transforms into a Doppelganger that pursues enemies. The Doppelganger inherits Sun's attributes, deals 60% of Sun's damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s. This skill shares its level and cooldown with Swift Exchange.

Sun hurls his Golden Staff in the target direction, dealing 280 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. He conjures a Doppelganger at his location that inherits his attributes, deals 60% damage, and takes 150% damage for 5s. Sun transforms into the Golden Staff and becomes concealed, reappearing at its maximum range.
Sun summons a Doppelganger that inherits his attributes, deals 80% damage, and takes 120% damage for 8s.

Tap-casting any skill puts Suyou in Mortal Form, granting 40 Movement Speed and reducing the interval between his Basic Attacks. Hold-casting any skill puts Suyou in Immortal Form, increasing his Basic Attack damage to 125% and granting 20% Physical Damage Reduction. In this form, Suyou gains 1% Physical Damage Reduction for every 20 extra Physical Attack he has, up to 40%.

Tap: Suyou throws his weapon in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Suyou then blinks to the weapon's location, catches it, and performs a slash in the opposite direction, dealing 375 (+150% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Hold: Suyou channels the Immortal's power and charges in the target direction, dealing 250 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the path. When hitting an enemy hero, he stops and stuns enemies in a rectangular area in front for 0.6s. The charge distance increases with the hold time. Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.

Tap: Suyou performs a sweeping attack with his weapon, dealing Physical Damage equal to 280 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 15% of target's lost HP) to enemies in a fan-shaped area. Hold: Suyou channels the power of the Immortal to perform 3 cleaves in a fan-shaped area. The first two strikes deal 225 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the final strike deals 360 (+128% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and recovers 150 (+50% Extra Physical Attack) HP for himself.

Tap: Suyou glides backward and swings his weapon in the target direction, dealing 420 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area and on his path backward, and reducing their Movement Speed by 30% for 1.5s. Hold: Suyou uses the Immortal's power to shoot a deadly arrow in the target direction, dealing 580 (+165% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target hit. The range increases with the hold time. Suyou can be controlled while charging, but the skill cannot be interrupted.
Terizla gains 1% extra Damage Reduction (up to 20 (+1*Hero Level)%) for every 2.5% HP lost. He cannot gain extra Attack Speed and will convert every 1% extra Attack Speed into 1 Physical Attack.

Terizla strikes the ground with his hammer, sending a fissure forward that deals 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting its first target, the fissure burrows into them, slowing them by 15%. Terizla also gains 15% Movement Speed for 3.5s. The fissure then explodes, dealing 300 (+80% Extra Physical Attack) (+ 20% of the target's lost HP) Physical Damage.

Terizla swings his hammer in a fan-shaped area ahead. This skill can be cast up to 3 times. The first two attacks deal 90 (+135% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each, while the third deals 225 (+220% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies hit will also be slowed by 20% for 1.25s (the Slowing Effect can stack). Deals only 80% damage to Minions.

Terizla jumps to the designated area, dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s. He then summons Scaffold and slows enemies by 25%. Scaffold will send out a hook at enemy heroes in range and pull them several times while dealing 150 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage each time.

Thamuz's Basic Attacks have a chance of 10%–60% (scaling with Lava's Rage) to conjure Lava Energy beneath the target that erupts after a brief delay, dealing 55 (+60% Total Physical Attack)(+8*Hero Level) True Damage. Basic Attacks that don't trigger Lava Energy increase Thamuz's Lava's Rage. While Thamuz is without his Scythes, he gains 25% Movement Speed. After retrieving his Scythes, his next Basic Attack slows the target by 30% and is guaranteed to trigger Lava Energy.

Thamuz tosses Scythes in the target direction. After traveling a set distance or hitting the first enemy hero, they deal 120 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. The Scythes will then slow nearby enemies by 30% and deal 45 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s. After leaving Thamuz for a short time or reaching a set distance, the Scythes return to him, dragging enemies along their path toward Thamuz. Thamuz can move toward the Scythes or cast the skill again to retrieve them.

Thamuz jumps to a designated area to deal 230 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the enemy units by 25% for 2s upon landing. If the Scythes are still travelling, they will return to Thamuz and Molten Scythes will reset its CD instantly.

Thamuz spouts the lava within, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and creating a Cauterant Zone around himself. The Cauterant Zone lasts 9s and deals 30 (+10% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage every 0.5s to enemies in the area. Meanwhile, Thamuz gains 800 (+50% Extra Max HP) HP, immediately healing for the same amount, and gains 60% Attack Speed. Each time his Basic Attacks or Scythes deal damage, he recovers 1.5% Max HP.

Tigreal gains 1 stack of Fearless each time he is hit by a Basic Attack. At 4 stacks, he consumes them to block the next incoming Basic Attack (including attacks from Turrets). He also gains 1 stack of Fearless each time he casts a skill. Damage from minions does not add or consume Fearless stacks.

Tigreal smashes the ground with his hammer, sending a shockwave that erupts 3 times in a fan-shaped area. Each eruption deals 270 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit and slows them by 20% / 40% / 60% for 1.5s.

Tigreal charges in a target direction, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and pushing them to the end of the charge. Used Again: Tigreal can cast this skill again within 4 seconds, dealing 280-380 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in front of him and knocking them airborne for 1 second.

Tigreal unleashes the power of his hammer, pulling nearby enemies to him, dealing 600 (+130% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning them for 1.8s. The first half of the channeling can be interrupted by control effects, while the second half can only be interrupted by Suppression.

Uranus absorbs the energy generated by incoming attacks to strengthen theirself, regenerating a certain amount of HP every 0.8s. Each stack lasts 10s. When at max stacks (20), Uranus regenerates 48-224 HP (scales with level).

Uranus releases 2 energy blades that orbit around him, dealing 155 (+30% Total Magic Power) (+6 × Radiance stacks) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2s. Each blade can only damage the same target once.

Uranus charges to the target location, dealing 80 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way, and 160 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies at the target location and slowing them by 25%. Uranus also generates a 300 (+200% Total Magic Power) shield for 4s. The shield explodes at the end of its duration or when destroyed, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies nearby.

Uranus unleashes the energy stored within his body, removing slow effects on himself, recovering 200 HP, and gaining 60% Movement Speed for 8s (decays over time). Uranus directly gains 5 stacks of Radiance, increasing shields received and HP Regen by 20% for 8s.
Vale gains 1 stack of Windtalk each time he gets a kill or an assist that increases his Movement Speed by 8. This effect can stack up to 10 times.
Vale unleashes two wind blades toward the left and right of a target area, each dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

Vale sends a whirlwind in the target direction, dealing 350 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s (each enemy can only be knocked airborne 1 time). When the whirlwind reaches its destination, it will remain for 1.6s while continuously dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in range.

Vale summons a windstorm at the target location, dealing a total of 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area and slowing them by 20% while continuously pulling them into its center. After 1s, the windstorm will explode, dealing 900 (+240% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. The remaining whirlwinds will also be pulled into the center.

Valentina gains 8-50 extra EXP (scales with level) each time she deals damage to an enemy hero. Cooldown: 2s. If the enemy hero's level is not higher than hers, 30% of the damage dealt is converted into her HP.

Valentina casts Shadow Strike in the target direction, dealing 475 (+145% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 40% for 1s. Enemy heroes hit are marked with a Shadow Sigil for 4s. Marked enemies hit by Shadow Strike again are Terrified for 1s (a target can only be terrified once every 4s).

Valentina dashes in the target direction, firing 3 Shadow Bolts at nearby enemies that deal 90 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage each. She can cast this skill again within 6s (costs Mana). Each time a Shadow Bolt hits an enemy, the cooldown of Shadow Strike is reduced by 1s.
