Valentina slows the target enemy hero by 70% for 0.5s and gains the ability to cast their Ultimate. Casting the enemy's Ultimate turns her into the enemy hero's form and inherits their Basic Attack type for up to 12s (her regular skills remain unchanged unless the enemy's Ultimate has a Morph effect). The stolen Ultimate's level equals Valentina's own Ultimate level, and its cooldown is 120% of the target's (but no lower than 10s). If the target is a Physical Damage hero, Valentina gains (+100% Total Magic Power) Physical Attack for the duration. This cannot be used on an enemy Valentina.

Valir's skills apply a stack of Ablaze to enemies hit, dealing them Magic Damage equal to 1 (+0.2% Total Magic Power)% of their HP per second for 3s. At 3 stacks, the fire detonates, dealing Magic Damage equal to 5 (+1% Total Magic Power)% of the target's HP and stunning them for 1s. A target can only be stunned by Valir's skills once every 7s.

Valir launches a fireball that explodes upon hitting the first target, dealing 235 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by 30% for 1s. The flame on the ground explodes after 1s, dealing 118 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Valir recharges 1 fireball every 9s (up to 2 charges). Hitting an enemy hero or legend creep with this skill immediately restores 1 charge, while hitting a minion restores 4s of the recharge time. Vengeance Flame: Increases the cast range of Burst Fireball by 30%.

Valir unleashes a torrent of flames in the target direction, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and knocking them back to the end of its path. Vengeance Flame: The torrent forms a firewall at the end of its path that lasts 4s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies every 1s. Enemies hit by the torrent or the firewall are slowed by 25% for 1s.
Valir removes all debuffs on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed that decays over 3s. Meanwhile, he conjures 4 Vengeance Flames that enhance Burst Fireball and Searing Torrent for 9s.

Vexana and her Eternal Guard inflict Nether Touch on enemies hit. The mark lasts 5s and causes the affected enemy to explode upon death, dealing 108-500 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies (base damage scales with level).

Vexana unleashes a Deathly Grasp in the target direction, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path. It stops upon hitting an enemy hero, Terrifying and knocking them back. After a short delay, it explodes, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and Terrifying them for 1s.
Vexana marks the target area with the power of the undead, striking it after a 0.8s delay and dealing 580 (+165% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

Vexana summons an Eternal Guard at the target location, dealing 480 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 0.8s. The Eternal Guard then joins Vexana in battle for 15s. Its attacks deal 200 (+40% Total Magic Power) (+ 5% target's HP) Magic Damage and Splash Damage in a large area.

Enemy heroes hit by Wanwan's attacks will have their weaknesses and positions exposed for 5s. When hitting an enemy's weakness, Wanwan deals 67 (+3*Hero Level) extra True Damage and increases their damage taken from her subsequent attacks by 10% for 5s. Wanwan can dash a short distance after each arrow fired from her Basic Attack. The dash speed scales with her Attack Speed.

Wanwan throws a Fire Swallow in the target direction, triggering Tiger Pace while dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The Fire Swallow then turns into 3 rotating Swallow Daggers. After a short delay, these Swallow Daggers will fly back to Wanwan one after another, dealing 120 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies on their way back and slowing them by 30% for 1.5s. Enemies hit twice by the Swallow Daggers will be immobilized for 0.5s.
Wanwan removes all debuffs on herself and triggers Tiger Pace. Meanwhile, she shoots Deadly Needles in all directions, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit.

Wanwan leaps into the air and becomes untargetable, firing arrows at the target enemy hero for 2.5s in rapid succession, dealing 60 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per arrow. If the target is killed during this attack, Wanwan will switch to another enemy hero in her attack range, gain 30% Attack Speed, and extend the skill duration by 1s (this effect can trigger up to 3 times). Wanwan can trigger Tiger Pace upon killing an enemy and at the end of the duration. Crossbow of Tang can only be cast on enemy heroes with all their weaknesses hit and Wanwan gains 100% Movement Speed during the duration. This damage is regarded as Basic Attack damage, and the firing rate scales with Wanwan's Attack Speed.

Firaga Armor inherits 160% of X.Borg's HP and absorbs all incoming damage when it's active. When destroyed, X.Borg rolls in the direction of the Joystick (he is invincible during this process). The Armor's energy will gradually regenerate while X.Borg is in the Armorless State. At full energy, X.Borg re-equips the Armor and restores it to 30% HP. X.Borg's attacks cause enemies to enter the Overheated state. Enemies in the Overheated state will drop Firaga Supplies when they take damage from X.Borg. Picking up supplies restores 10% of the Armor's HP (or 10 Energy while in the Armorless State). X.Borg's skills deal True Damage to enemies in the Overheated state.

X.Borg sprays fire, dealing 25 (+60% Total Physical Attack) (+40% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 7 times over 2s to enemies in front of him (75% damage to minions). Armorless State: The attack area becomes narrower but longer, while the damage is reduced to 60%.

X.Borg fires 5 Fire Stakes forward and recalls them after 1.7s. Each stake deals 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and pulls enemies and Firaga Supplies along its path back to him. Armorless State: X.Borg adjusts the Fire Stake launcher, making the stakes travel farther and closer together.

X.Borg charges in the target direction while spinning and spraying fire (cannot pick up Firaga Supplies during this time), dealing 90 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) (+45% Total Magic Power) Physical Damage 12 times and slowing enemies hit by 25%. He stops upon touching an enemy hero and will slow them by an additional 40%. After 3s, his mecha suit detonates, dealing 300 (+ 15% target's HP) True Damage. If his armor is destroyed, it will immediately explode, but damage drops to 50%. The detonation destroys his armor, removes all control effects, and collects all nearby Firaga Supplies. Cannot be used in Armorless State. Use Again: Immediately stop spraying fire and detonate early.

When Xavier's skills hit enemy heroes, he gains 60% Movement Speed for 1.2s (decays over time) and 1 energy charge. At 3 charges, his next skill triggers the Transcendence state. Transcendence: In this state, Xavier's Skills 1 and 2 have their cooldowns reduced by 4s, and his Ultimate by 36s. Transcendence lasts 5s and can be extended by 1s each time his skills hit enemies.

Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 480 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies it passes through. The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the Mystic Barrier (up to 5 times).

Xavier summons a Mystic Barrier that lasts 5s. Enemies touching the Barrier are slowed by 50%, while allies gain 50% extra Movement Speed (decays over 1.2s). When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a Mystic Field for 3s, dealing 440 (+130% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 0.8s.

Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 600 (+180% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies along its path. Once cast, he also directly enters the Transcendence state and resets the state's duration.

Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow or glaive based on his distance from the target. Weapon Mastery: After each weapon swap, his next 2 Basic Attacks gain extra Attack Speed and deal 70% and 55% Crit Damage respectively. He also gains 15% Movement Speed for 1s.

Yi Sun-shin dashes forward and slashes with his glaive, dealing 150 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and gaining Control Immunity for 0.4s. Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces the cooldown of Traceless by 1s.

Tap: Yi Sun-shin slashes swiftly with his glaive, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Hold: Yi Sun-shin shoots a powerful arrow forward, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (damage scales with hold time, up to 200%). Casting this skill immediately triggers Weapon Mastery.

Yi Sun-shin summons a turtle ship and reveals the whole map for 2s. The turtle ship lasts up to 10s, during which he gains 70% burst Movement Speed (decays to 20% over 2s). Use Again: Yi Sun-shin commands the turtle ship to ram the target area, dealing 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the center and stunning them for 0.8s. Meanwhile, he commands the naval fleet to launch 3 waves of cannon attacks over a larger area. Each wave deals 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slows enemies by 30%. Casting this skill immediately triggers Weapon Mastery.
If there are no allied heroes within 4 units of Yin, his damage is increased to 120% and he gains 8% Spell Vamp.

Yin gains 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3s). During this time, his next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 25 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the enhanced Basic Attack hits an enemy, Yin throws a charged punch forward, dealing 360 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. Successfully throwing the charged punch reduces the skill's cooldown by 35%.

Yin dashes forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind while dealing 75 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4s if an enemy hero is hit. After 1s, the Golden Ring will catch up with Yin, dealing 150 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1s.

After a short delay, Yin locks onto an enemy hero (cannot lock onto pets or clones) and pulls them into a domain for up to 8s and turns into Lieh. When in the domain, the two cannot be affected by other heroes' skills. Lieh has stronger skills and 50 extra Physical Defense and Magic Defense that last 8s. The domain will end early if either of the two is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he'll recover 20% of his Max HP, leave the domain with the cooldowns of Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast reset, and continue to fight as Lieh for 8s. If Yin fails to pull his target into the domain, the skill will enter a 3s cooldown.

Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to enemy heroes every time he deals Physical damage to them. Sha Residue erupts upon reaching 5 stacks a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4 seconds to deal Physical Damage equal to 20 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) (+2.5% of target's Lost HP) to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When Sha Residue erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed by 3 seconds.

Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.

Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1s. Upon hitting an enemy, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 108 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting multiple enemies, the enhanced Basic Attack will apply multiple stacks of Sha Residue and deal up to 200% damage.

After channeling for 0.6s, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7s, he cannot use other skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in his path while dealing 180 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He also gains 1000 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form. Upon exiting the Black Dragon Form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid Form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10s.

When Yve deals damage to enemy heroes with her skills, she gains Galactic Power (cooldown: 0.5s), up to 3 stacks. Each stack provides Yve with a 120 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s.

Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 290 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area. Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decreases over 1s.

Yve summons a Void Crystal at the target location, dealing 220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies. Use Again: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 75 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 20%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 4% for each hit after the first hit (up to 40%).

Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 20 times. Tap: Deals 340 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the target area. Swipe: Deals 85 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 40%. Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target). Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).

Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s (up to 10 stacks). Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who approaches her, dealing 90 (+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. She also gains a 300 (+20*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s. Cooldown: 120s.

Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave (up to 3 times). Zetian can cast other skills during this time. The waves deal 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), 150 (+50% Total Magic Power), and 360 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, respectively. The 3rd wave has a larger area and pulls enemies toward the cast direction (not considered a control effect). The Spell Vamp ratio against minions is only 65%.

Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10% while revealing their surrounding area. While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.

Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time. Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.
Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55% of his HP, Hybrid Defense, and Magic Power. It automatically fires Death Ray at nearby enemies, dealing 55 (+ 20%Magic Power) (+ 20% Extra Attack Speed) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30%. It disappears when Zhask moves too far away. Death Ray is considered a Basic Attack but cannot Crit. Fusion Enhanced: Nightmaric Spawn deals 180% damage and can be repositioned.

Zhask fires a penetrating psychic beam in the target direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, the Nightmaric Spawn attacks enemies hit by Mind Eater, dealing 120 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.5s. Fusion Enhanced: Mind Eater damage is increased to 540 (+180% Total Magic Power).

Zhask selects a target area to summon an enhanced Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra attributes. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period. Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off the Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.

Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 5% of her Max Mana. Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.

Zhuxin deals 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of Soul Snare. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20% and gains 20% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.

Hold: Hold the skill button to move the Spirit Lantern. It deals 35 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in range every 0.33s (Magic Bonus increases to 60% against minions) and applies Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit. When an enemy hero reaches 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies capture them, pulling them airborne for 1s. Release: Throw all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 200 (+150% Total Magic Power) (+ 10% captured target's HP) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. If an enemy is hit multiple times, subsequent damage decays by 80%. After a target is captured, Soul Snare cannot stack on them again for 4s. During this time, this skill deals 15% extra damage to that target.

Zhuxin blinks to the target location, gaining a 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) shield and creating a field for 6s. The field deals 30 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to nearby enemies every 0.5s.

After dealing damage 3 time(s) with Basic Attacks or skills, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 time(s). Each hit deals 80 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Basic Attack Damage and heals himself for 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP. Zilong's Basic Attack deals 100 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.
Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.

Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Physical Defense by 15 for 2s. The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.

Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5s. During this time, Dragon Flurry triggers every 2 attacks (instead of the previous 3).

column3: Deter: When hit by a skill, reduces the attacker's Physical Damage by 6% for 2 seconds (this effect stacks up to 3 times).
Judgement: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 50 extra True Damage (1.5 seconds cooldown).
Doom: When Basic Attacks Crit, they deal extra True Damage equal to 12% of the damage before reduction.
Fortress Shield: For each enemy hero within 3.55 units, Hybrid Defense is increased by 4, up to 20.

Bladed Armor: When struck by a Basic Attack, deals Physical Damage equal to 30 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of the incoming damage (calculated before Damage Reduction) to the attacker and slows them by 15% for 1 second.
Despair: Dealing damage to non-Minion enemies below 50% HP increases Physical Attack by 25% for 2 seconds (takes effect before the damage is dealt).

Ambush: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5 seconds (excluding from Minions or Creeps), the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 160 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 1.5 seconds.

Guard: Gains a 800 (+100% Magic Power) Shield that will regenerate 20 seconds after being damaged. The Shield also grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts and 150 Movement Speed for 1 second after it breaks.
Brute Force: Each second after dealing damage, gain 8 extra Adaptive Attack and 2% extra Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Gain 25% extra Control Duration Reduction at full stacks.
Bud of Hope: Granted by Floryn and Dew. The equipment will reveal its true power once Dew evolves.

Calamity: In 3 seconds after using the skill, the casters next Basic Attack deals additional True Damage as much as 120% of Magic Power with a cooldown of 1.5 seconds. Then briefly gains 10% Movement Speed.

Chastise: Taking damage will reduce the Attack Speed and Attack Speed cap of the attacker to 75% of normal for 2 seconds. Redemption: When incoming damage reduces HP below 30%, recover 20% Max HP over the next 2 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.

Destiny: Gains 4.5(+0.5*Hero Level) Hybrid Defense for 5 seconds when dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes, stacking up to 6 times (can gain 1 stack every 0.4 seconds). Gift: When HP drops below 50%, recovers 15% of HP over the next 3 seconds. When Mana drops below 50%, restores 15% of Mana over the next 3 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.

Recharge: Increases Magic Power by 5 after dealing Magic Damage (this effect stacks up to 6 times and can only gain 1 stack every 0.4 seconds). When reaching full stacks, increases Magic Damage by 12% for 5 seconds.

Corrosive: Basic Attacks gain 80 extra Physical Damage and slow the target by 8% (halved for ranged Basic Attacks) for 1.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times. Impulse: Basic Attacks grant 6% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds, capped at 5 stacks.

Burning Soul: Deals (1.2% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second. This damage is increased by 125(+15*Hero Level)% against creeps and minions. Curse: Dealing damage with Burning Soul will reduce the target's Hybrid Defense by 3 for 3 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.

Engulf: Basic Attacks deal 8% of the target's current HP as extra Physical Damage (capped at 60 against minions). Devour: Each Basic Attack recovers 10(+4*Hero Level) HP. This effect is halved against minions.
Mysticism: Getting a kill or assist on an enemy Minion will restore 4% Mana. (An assist occurs when a Minion dies within 2 seconds after taking damage from the hero.)
Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.

Fortress Shield: For each enemy hero within 5 units, Hybrid Defense is increased by 8, up to 40. Lifebane: Reduces Shield and HP Regen effects of nearby enemies within 5 units to 60% of normal for 1 second.
Deter: When hit by a skill, reduces the attacker's Physical Damage by 4% for 2 seconds (this effect stacks up to 3 times).
Gift: When HP drops below 50%, recovers 15% of HP over the next 3 seconds. When Mana drops below 50%, restores 15% of Mana over the next 3 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
Mana Spring: Regenerates 15% of Max Mana every 10 seconds. Magic Mastery: Max Cooldown Reduction is increased by 5%.

Divine Justice: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals (60% Total Physical Attack) extra True Damage and recovers 80 (+40% of Total Physical Attack) HP (1.5 seconds cooldown).
Affliction: Each Basic Attack deals extra 50 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Impulse: Basic Attacks grant 6% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds, capped at 5 stacks.

Blessing: When casting a healing or shield skill, if the target's HP is below 35%, or falls below 35% within 3 seconds, they will get a (100*Hero Level) shield that lasts 3 seconds. When this effect triggers, it also reduces the cooldown of the caster's skills by 2 seconds. (This effect can only trigger once every 60 seconds on the same target, and will not trigger on self-only healing and shield skills.)
Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.
Flower of Hope: Every 6 seconds, the next skill or Basic Attack deals an additional 60 (+30% Total Physical Attack) (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Magic: Dealing Magic Damage to enemy heroes will reduce their Magic Defense by 2.5+(0.5*Hero Level) for 2 seconds. Stacks up to 3 times.

Scorch: Dealing Magic Damage burns the targets for 3 seconds, also dealing extra Magic Damage equal to 1% of the target's Max HP per second. Lifebane: Dealing damage to the target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds.

Swift: Every 1% extra Crit Chance gained is converted into 1% extra Attack Speed. Endless Strike: After every 2 non-Crit Basic Attacks, the Attack Speed of the next Basic Attack is increased by 80% (and Attack Speed cap is increased to 500%) and triggers Attack Effects an additional 2 time(s).
Supreme Warrior: After casting an Ultimate, increase Movement Speed by 30% for 7.5 seconds. This effect has a 15 seconds cooldown.

Recovery: After 5 seconds out of combat, recover (2.5% Total HP) HP per second. Defender: Upon taking more than 500 damage in a single instance, recover 30 (+0.3% Total HP)% HP from the excess damage beyond that amount.
Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 20% extra Attack Speed for 2 seconds.
Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).
Retribution: Dealing damage to the same enemy hero or creep 5 times in a row grants 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 3 seconds (8 seconds cooldown).
Ice Bound: When a skill deals damage to an enemy hero, it will also slow them by 10% for 2 seconds (stacks up to 3 times). This effect has a 0.4 seconds cooldown.
Immortal: Resurrect 2.5 seconds upon death and gets 16% Max HP and a shield that can absorb 150(+70*Hero Level）damage. Shield lasts 3 seconds. This effect has a 210 seconds cooldown.
Lantern of Hope: The equipment's attributes scale with hero level.
Resonate: Every 6 seconds, the next skill echoes, dealing 255 (+85% Magic Power) extra Magic Damage to all enemies in range.

Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gains a (+60*Hero Level) shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.
Increase Power: Automatically used after purchasing, increases Magic Power by 30 and Cooldown Reduction by 10% for 120s. Can only have one potion effect at a time.
Armor Buster: Increase Physical Penetration by 30%. Malefic Energy: Increases Basic Attack range by 12%. When hitting a target, gains 10% Movement Speed for 0.5 seconds.
Armor Buster: Increase Physical Penetration by 30%. Breaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Physical Penetration for each point of the enemy's Physical Defense, capped at 30%.
Burning Soul: Deals (0.6% Total HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second. This damage is increased by 125(+15*Hero Level)% against creeps and minions.
Gift: Regens 20% HP and Mana within 2 seconds of leveling up. Lifebane: Upon dealing damage to the target, reduces Shield and HP Regen of the target by 50% for 3 seconds.
Bless: Received Shield and HP Regen effects are increased by 25%.
Increase Power: Automatically used after purchasing, giving 30 Physical Attack and 15% of Lifesteal for 120s. Can only have one potion effect at a time.

Demonize: When HP drops below 40%, gains 30% Damage Reduction for 3 seconds and reduces skill cooldowns by 2 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown. Defiance: For every 1% HP lost, damage is increased by 0.25%, up to 15%.
Holy Blessing: Taking Magic Damage grants 5(+1*Hero Level) Magic Defense for 5 seconds, up to 6 stacks (can only gain 1 stack(s) every 0.4 seconds).
Increase Power: Upon purchase, grants 500 Max HP and 5% Damage Reduction for 120 seconds. Can only have one potion effect at a time.

Dragon Scale: Every 4 extra Physical Attack increases Hybrid Defense by 1, up to 50 (effect is halved if Main Role is not Fighter). Lifeline: When taking damage that reduces HP below 30%, gains a (120*Hero Level) shield (increases with level) and 50% Movement Speed that rapidly decays over 3 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.
Frenzy: Critical strikes grant 30% extra Attack Speed and 5% extra Crit Chance for 2 seconds.
Lifebane: Dealing damage to a target will reduce the Shield and HP Regen effects on them to 60% of normal for 3 seconds. Punish: Increase damage by 8% against enemy heroes with higher extra HP.

Assassination: If no damage is taken or dealt within 5 sseconds, the next Basic Attack will deal extra Magic Damage equal to 200 plus 50% Magic Power, and inflict 60% slow effects upon the target for 1.5 seconds.
Floryn can share the power of Dew's Lantern with an allied hero. The Lantern is not strong enough yet and can evolve once it absorbs enough energy in battle.

Lethality: After dealing damage to an enemy hero, executes the hero if their HP is lower than 4%. Gains 10 stack(s) of Lethality for each kill and loses 30% current stack(s) for each death. Each stack of Lethality increases the HP threshold of the execute effect by 0.1%, stacking up 80 times.

Crisis: After casting a skill, the next Basic Attack within 3 seconds deals 90 (+60% Total Magic Power) extra True Damage and reduces the target's Movement Speed by 15% for 1.5 seconds (1.5 seconds cooldown).
Crossbow: Each Basic Attack deals 40 extra Adaptive Damage. Impulse: Basic Attacks grant 3% extra Attack Speed for 3 seconds, capped at 5 stacks.

Thunderbolt: Every 4 seconds, the next Basic Attack deals 50 (+100% Extra Physical Defense) (+100% Extra Magic Defense) extra True Damage to the target and enemies around them, and briefly slows them by 99%. Hybrid Defense permanently increases by 1 each time the attack hits an enemy hero. (This effect is reduced to 50% for Marksmen, Mages, and Assassins)
Fortitude: CC and Slow Duration reduced by 25%.

Twilight: Upon taking more than 500 damage in a single instance, the excess damage beyond that amount is reduced by 20 (+0.2% Total HP)%. Redemption: When incoming damage reduces HP below 30%, recover 20% Max HP over the next 4 seconds. This effect has a 60 seconds cooldown.

Shield: Upon taking Magic Damage from enemy hero skills or Basic Attacks, reduces Magic Damage taken by 25% for 3 seconds (including the damage that triggers the effect)s. Regains this effect 5 seconds after leaving combat.

Fighting Spirit: Attacks grants 12 extra Physical Attack per second for 4 seconds, up to 6 stacks. Deals 10% extra True Damage based on the damage dealt (no damage reduction counted) at full stacks. (Marksmen, Mages, and Supports only receive 50% of these stacked effects.)
Valor: Gains 4 extra Physical Defense for 3 seconds when taking Physical Damage, up to 20.

column4: Wind Chant: Become immune to all Physical Damage for 2 seconds (duration is halved if Main Role is not Marksman; 90 seconds cooldown).

column3: Typhoon: Every 5–2 seconds (reduced by 0.2 seconds for each Basic Attack), the next Basic Attack will hit up to 3 enemy units for 150–362 Magic Damage. (This attack can Crit and the damage increases to 200% against Minions.)

column4: Frozen: Becomes frozen, untargetable, and immune to damage for 2 seconds (100 seconds cooldown). Cannot move or cast skills while frozen, but skills already cast won't be interrupted.

column3: Butterfly Goddess: For every 900 Magic Damage dealt to an enemy hero (calculated before Damage Reduction), a Butterfly Goddess is summoned to attack the enemy hero, dealing Magic Damage equal to 8% of their Current HP.
